name: Baldwin La Brea Certified Farmers' Market
tagline: Plan Your Visit to Farmer's Daughter Produce, Brentwood CA
description: Baldwin La Brea Certified Farmers' Market gathers local farms and food producers in Rodeo and La Brea, CA. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
